answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The signal lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the violet is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the falcon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
